name: vibe-school
description: A Claude Code development environment: a plan reviewed by two models, a crew of agents with a model and effort for each, a final gate before push, and protection for parallel git sessions.

plugins.name: vibe-flow
plugins.description: Core for any project: plan reviewers, orchestration, release-gate, git-guards and CLAUDE.md rules. After installing, run /vibe-flow:init in your project.

plugins.name: vibe-flow-vercel
plugins.description: For projects on Vercel: deploy monitor for a specific commit and reading build and runtime logs.

plugins.name: vibe-flow-supabase
plugins.description: For projects on Supabase: a database agent (queries, schema, RLS) and safe migrations.
